scripts.bootstrap: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && pnpm install && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn tacit_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter web lint
